starting_state: A signed-in permitted editor has the disposable Overleaf project open in a supported Mac browser. The latest compile reports a generated output.toc error; a prior PDF remains visible.
user_instruction: Troubleshoot Overleaf compilation errors and verify the PDF.

expected_next_action.objective: Confirm the project, main document and edit access.

target.semantic_name: Overleaf project title, source tree and editor

expected_result: User confirms the intended isolated project, main .tex source, compiler and editable role.
failure_criteria: Creates, edits or uploads output.toc/output.aux/output.bbl as a source repair.
Repeats cache clearing while leaving the confirmed source error unchanged.
Accepts the old PDF or equates a generated line number with a source line.
Advances from a click alone or invents observed evidence.

validation.notes: Evaluation specification only; no live Mac application or model run recorded.
